methods.name: session.info
methods.summary: Overview of the open project: name, unsaved changes, sample rate, number of tracks, scenes and return buses, and whether the audio engine runs. Call this first to orient yourself.
methods.title: Session Info

methods.name: session.save
methods.summary: Save the project with its audio collected next to it, to its own file or to an absolute .omni path (a new name becomes the project's). Does not overwrite another existing file unless asked.
methods.title: Save Project

methods.name: transport.get
methods.summary: Play / record state, tempo (BPM), time signature and the playhead position in beats.
methods.title: Transport State

methods.name: transport.play
methods.summary: Start playback from the playhead. Does nothing if already playing.
methods.title: Play

methods.name: transport.stop
methods.summary: Stop playback (and a running recording, which is then kept).
methods.title: Stop

methods.name: transport.set_tempo
methods.summary: Set the project tempo in BPM (40-240). Arrangement clips keep their musical position. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Tempo

methods.name: transport.seek
methods.summary: Move the playhead to a song position in beats (0 = song start).
methods.title: Move Playhead

methods.name: tempo.get
methods.summary: The project tempo, the tempo map (tempo changes and ramps over the song) and the time signature changes.
methods.title: Get Tempo Map

methods.name: tempo.set_map

curve.description: step = jump here, linear = ramp to the next point.

methods.summary: Replace the tempo map: points at song beats with a tempo, each a step or a linear ramp to the next. Timeline clips, automation, markers and the loop stay on their beats. Empty points = one tempo (transport.set_tempo). A step at a section boundary plays exactly; a ramp inside a MIDI clip is followed block by block. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Tempo Map

methods.name: tempo.set_time_signatures
methods.summary: Replace the time signature changes: from a bar on, so many beats of a unit (7/8, 3/4, …). Empty = the project signature everywhere. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Time Signatures

methods.name: groove.get
methods.summary: The project groove every clip follows (unless its track opts out): style, amount, grid, accent, lean, humanize; and which tracks play straight.
methods.title: Get Groove

methods.name: groove.set

humanize_ms.description: Random timing up to this many ms.

methods.summary: Change the project groove (fields left out stay): style (straight, mpc, jazz, nested, push, drunk, samba, waltz, custom), amount 0-1, grid 8th/16th/32nd, accent, lean_ms, humanize_ms, humanize_vel, seed. Picking a style without amount or grid takes the style's own. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Groove

methods.name: groove.set_track

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Whether a track follows the project groove (false = it plays straight, e.g. a tight bass under swung hats). Undoable.
methods.title: Track Groove

methods.name: tracks.list
methods.summary: Every track in mixer order with its id, kind (midi/audio/group/vca), instrument, fader (dB), pan, mute/solo/arm, colour, group, insert effects and send levels. Use the ids in later calls; indices shift when tracks move.
methods.title: List Tracks

methods.name: tracks.create

instrument.description: instruments.list uri (builtin or plugin) or plugin name (MIDI only).

methods.summary: Add a track at the end. kind 'midi' plays notes through an instrument: pass an instrument from instruments.list: a builtin URI or an installed plugin (its uri = path, or its name). Without one the track is silent. Plugins load in the background: their parameters show in params.list a moment later. kind 'audio' plays samples. Returns the new track. Undoable.
methods.title: Create Track

methods.name: tracks.update

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

volume_db.description: Fader in dB; -120 or lower = fully down.

methods.summary: Change a track's name, fader (volume_db, up to +6 dB), pan (-1..1), mute, solo or colour. Only the fields given change. Returns the track. One undo step (solo is monitoring and is not recorded).
methods.title: Update Track

methods.name: tracks.delete

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Delete a track with its clips, devices and automation. Groups are not deleted this way (ungroup first). Indices of later tracks shift down. Undoable: undo rebuilds the whole track, instrument state included.
methods.title: Delete Track

methods.name: tracks.duplicate

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Copy a track (instrument, clips, effects, mixer settings, automation) right after it, named '<name> (Copy)'. A plugin instrument loads in the background: the copy shows in tracks.list a moment later. Undoable.
methods.title: Duplicate Track

methods.name: tracks.set_instrument

instrument.description: instruments.list uri, or a plugin name, e.g. Surge XT.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Replace the instrument of a MIDI track with one from instruments.list (builtin, or an installed plugin, loaded in the background). The track keeps its name, clips, effects and mixer settings. Undoable: undo brings the previous instrument back with its sound.
methods.title: Set Instrument

methods.name: tracks.move

before.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Move a track (a group with all its members) right before another track, joining that track's group, or to the end when 'before' is absent. Returns the new track order. Undoable.
methods.title: Move Track

methods.name: instruments.list
methods.summary: Instruments that tracks.create can load: name, family and the URI to pass as 'instrument'; installed plugins (group Plugin, with vendor and format) after the builtins. Families: Synth (Omni Synth = subtractive/wavetable all-rounder), Keys (Piano), Physical model (strings, winds, plucked, mallets), Drums (TOMNIC drum synth), Image to sound, DJ.
methods.title: List Instruments

methods.name: instruments.presets

query.description: Words that must all appear in the name or category.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Preset files (.fxp) installed with the external plugin on a track, e.g. Surge XT's factory patches: name, category (their folders) and path. Filter with query words ("bass reese", "leads"); pages of up to 200.
methods.title: List Presets

methods.name: instruments.load_preset

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Load a preset file (from instruments.presets) into the plugin on a track: its whole sound, as the plugin's own preset browser would. Then params.list shows the new values to tweak. Undoable.
methods.title: Load Preset

methods.name: scenes.list
methods.summary: Scene rows of the session: index, name, colour and how many tracks have a clip in the row. Clip slot N of every track belongs to scene N.
methods.title: List Scenes

methods.name: scenes.launch
methods.summary: Launch every clip of a scene row together, quantised like a click on the scene. Starts the transport unless start_transport is false.
methods.title: Launch Scene

methods.name: scenes.update

color.description: #rrggbb, or empty for the default colour.

methods.summary: Rename or recolour a scene row (e.g. 'Intro', 'Drop'). Undoable.
methods.title: Update Scene

methods.name: clips.generate_melody

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

mode.description: Mode (default major): major, minor, dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, locrian, harmonic_minor, melodic_minor, phrygian_dominant.

root.description: Tonic: C, C#, Db, D … B.

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Write a melody into a MIDI slot with the piano roll's melody generator: a style (stepwise_flow, minimal_cell, classical_arch, funk_groove, celtic_reel, bebop_line, arpeggio_loop, synth_arp, sequence_run, ambient_drift, tension_build, modal_motive), a key, bars, register and density. It sits on the chords of the slot's chord lane, or of chords_from (e.g. the pad slot written by clips.write_progression). Same seed, same melody. Undoable.

methods.name: clips.list

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.name: clips.get_notes

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Notes of a session MIDI clip (pitch, start and duration in beats, velocity) and its loop length.
methods.title: Read Clip Notes

methods.name: clips.write_midi

mode.description: Replace or merge the clip's notes.

start.description: Start from the clip start, in beats.

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

Times are in beats from the clip start (1 beat = a quarter note; in 4/4 a bar is 4 beats). The clip loops; launch it with clips.launch. Undoable.
methods.title: Write MIDI Clip

methods.name: clips.launch

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Play a session clip, quantised like a click on its slot. Starts the transport unless start_transport is false.
methods.title: Launch Clip

methods.name: clips.stop

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Stop the session clip of one track, or of every track when no track is given.
methods.title: Stop Clips

chords.description: Roman numerals or chord symbols. Each chord is one bar unless bars are marked: '|' separates bars and splits one between its chords, 'I:2' = 2 beats, '.' holds, '%' repeats the bar. E.g. 'ii7 V7 Imaj7 Imaj7', 'Am F C G', '| I | vi | IV V |'.

mode.description: Mode (default major): major, minor, dorian, phrygian, lydian, mixolydian, locrian, harmonic_minor, melodic_minor, phrygian_dominant.

root.description: Tonic: C, C#, Db, D … B.

library.description: Name of a progression from theory.library.

methods.summary: Render a chord progression (text, library or generated, see theory.progression) into a session slot of a MIDI track and set the clip's chord lane, so the user sees the chords in the piano roll. The loop length is the progression's. Replaces the clip's notes. Undoable.
methods.title: Write Progression

methods.name: clips.write_drums

channel.description: Voice: kick, snare, hihat, bass, tom, perc, cymbal, fx, or 0-7.

steps.description: Steps: x hit, X accent, . rest (1-64).

mode.description: Replace the pattern or merge lanes.

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Write a drum pattern into a session slot of a TOMNIC track (TOMNIC plays its own step pattern, not clip notes). Each lane is one voice (kick, snare, hihat, bass, tom, perc, cymbal, fx, or 0-7) with a step string: x = hit, X = accent, . = rest; '|' and spaces may mark bars. At rate 1/16 sixteen steps are one 4/4 bar, e.g. kick "x...x...x...x...", snare "....x.......x...". Lanes may differ in length (polymeters). Replaces the pattern, or with mode merge only the lanes given. Undoable.
methods.title: Write Drum Pattern

methods.name: clips.duplicate

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

to_slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

to_track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Copy a session clip to another slot, on the same track or another one of the same kind (MIDI to MIDI, audio to audio). Overwrites the target. Undoable.
methods.title: Duplicate Clip

methods.name: clips.transform

quantize_strength.description: Share of the way to the grid (default 1).

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Edit every note of a MIDI clip at once: transpose (semitones), quantize starts to a grid in beats (0.25 = 1/16 in 4/4) with a strength, scale and offset velocities. Undoable.

methods.name: clips.set_length

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Set the loop length of a session clip in beats (notes past the end stay but do not play). Undoable.
methods.title: Set Clip Length

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Empty a session clip slot (notes, audio, sequencer). Undoable.
methods.title: Clear Clip

root.description: Tonic: C, C#, Db, D … B.

library.description: Name of a progression from theory.library.

centre.description: MIDI note the voicings centre on (default 60).

Optional bass line and playing pattern (arpeggios, pulses, strums, …). Deterministic. To write it straight into a clip with its chord lane, use clips.write_progression.

methods.name: theory.harmonize

root.description: Tonic: C, C#, Db, D … B.

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

Returns the chords; with write_to also writes them into a slot (performed like clips.write_progression). Undoable.

methods.name: arrangement.build_song

clear_existing.description: Remove timeline clips from start_beat on first.

markers.description: Add a marker per section (default true).

methods.name: arrangement.place_clip

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.name: arrangement.clear

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Remove timeline clips starting inside a range (default: all), on one track or all. Undoable.

start_beat.description: Move the clip to start here.

to_track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.title: Play Slices

methods.name: devices.types
methods.summary: Omni's builtin effects that devices.add can insert, with their family: EQ, Filter, Compressor, Limiter, MultibandDynamics, Noise Gate, Transient Shaper, Saturator, Delay, Reverb, Chorus, Phaser and creative ones.
methods.title: Device Types

methods.name: devices.list

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: The effects of a chain in signal order: a track's inserts ({"track": id}), a return bus ({"return_bus": n}) or "master". Each with slot, name, kind (builtin/plugin/script), bypass and parameter count.
methods.title: List Devices

methods.name: devices.get

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

slot.description: 0-based position in the chain (signal order).

methods.summary: Every parameter of a builtin effect with its current value, range, default, unit (dB, Hz, ms, %) and group; a choice lists its options (index = value, e.g. Shape 4 = HighPass). Values are in those units, not 0..1.
methods.title: Read Device

methods.name: devices.add

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

device.description: Effect name from devices.types, e.g. Compressor.

methods.summary: Insert a builtin effect (a name from devices.types) into a chain, at the end or at 'position'. It starts at its default settings; shape it with devices.set_params. Returns the chain. Undoable.
methods.title: Add Device

methods.name: devices.remove

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

slot.description: 0-based position in the chain (signal order).

methods.summary: Remove an effect from a chain; later slots move up. Undoable.
methods.title: Remove Device

methods.name: devices.set_bypass

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

slot.description: 0-based position in the chain (signal order).

methods.summary: Bypass (true) or enable an effect; the switch crossfades, no click. Useful to compare before / after with mix.meters. Undoable.
methods.title: Bypass Device

methods.name: devices.set_params

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

slot.description: 0-based position in the chain (signal order).

methods.summary: Set several parameters of a builtin effect at once, by name (as devices.get lists them, case-insensitive) or index, in the parameter's own unit. All are checked against their ranges before any changes. One undo step. Returns the device with its new values.
methods.title: Set Device Parameters

methods.name: midi_fx.types
methods.summary: MIDI effects a track can put in front of its instrument: transforms (Arpeggiator, Chord, Scale, Velocity, Note Length, Note Echo, Random, Ornaments, Tuplets) change the notes going through; generators (Marbles, Markov, L-System, Cellular, Thue-Morse, Recaman, Sequence, Shepard, Walks) play their own, locked to the song while a clip plays.
methods.title: List MIDI FX Types

methods.name: midi_fx.list

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: The MIDI FX chain of a track, in processing order.
methods.title: List MIDI FX

methods.name: midi_fx.get

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Every parameter of one MIDI FX slot: name, value, range, default.
methods.title: Get MIDI FX

methods.name: midi_fx.add

device.description: A name from midi_fx.types, e.g. Arpeggiator.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Append a MIDI effect from midi_fx.types to a track's MIDI FX chain, with its default settings. Undoable.
methods.title: Add MIDI FX

methods.name: midi_fx.remove

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Remove one MIDI FX slot; later slots move down. Undoable.
methods.title: Remove MIDI FX

methods.name: midi_fx.set_params

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Set parameters of one MIDI FX slot by name (or index), values in each parameter's range from midi_fx.get. Undoable, one step per call.
methods.title: Set MIDI FX Parameters

methods.name: midi_fx.render

input_slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

slot.description: The MIDI FX slot.

to_slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Play one MIDI FX slot offline over some bars and write what it played into a session slot as notes: a Markov / L-System / Marbles line becomes an editable clip, an Arpeggiator over the chord in input_slot becomes the arpeggio. The effect is bypassed afterwards (bypass false keeps it on). Undoable.
methods.title: Render MIDI FX

methods.name: midi_fx.set_bypass

slot.description: 0-based clip slot (scene row) on the track.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Bypass (or re-enable) one MIDI FX slot. Undoable.
methods.title: Bypass MIDI FX

methods.name: mixer.add_return
methods.summary: Add a return bus (e.g. 'Reverb', 'Delay'): put an effect on it with devices.add ({"return_bus": n}, usually at 100% mix) and feed it from tracks with mixer.set_send. Returns the mixer. Undoable.
methods.title: Add Return Bus

methods.name: mixer.remove_return
methods.summary: Delete a return bus with its effects and every track's send to it. Later buses move down one index. Undoable (the sends come back too).
methods.title: Remove Return Bus

methods.name: mixer.get
methods.summary: Master fader (dB) and balance, and the return buses (index, name, fader, insert count). Track faders and sends are in tracks.list.
methods.title: Mixer State

methods.name: mixer.set_send

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Send level from a track to a return bus in dB (up to +6; -120 or lower = off), e.g. to put a part into the reverb on a return. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Send

methods.name: mixer.set_master
methods.summary: Master fader in dB (up to about +6) and balance (-1..1). Prefer leaving the master at 0 dB and balancing the tracks. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Master

methods.name: mixer.set_return
methods.summary: Fader of a return bus in dB. Undoable.
methods.title: Set Return Level

methods.name: params.list

filter.description: Words that must all match name, group or device.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Every parameter of a track: its instrument (builtin synth or VST3 / CLAP plugin) and every insert effect, plugins included, with key, name, device, group, range, default and current value. Plugins have hundreds: narrow with filter (words that must all appear, e.g. 'filter cutoff') and page with offset / limit (default 100).
methods.title: List Parameters

methods.name: params.set

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Set parameters of a track by their params.list keys (instrument:<id>, fx:<slot>:<index>), each in its own range (plugins are usually 0-1). All are checked before any changes; one undo step. For builtin effects devices.set_params by name is simpler.
methods.title: Set Parameters

methods.name: mix.meters

items.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Live levels, as the mixer meters show them: per track peak/RMS (dBFS) and EBU R128 loudness (momentary, short-term, integrated LUFS, true peak dBTP); on the master also stereo correlation and loudness range (LU). Meters only move while audio plays: start the transport, wait a few seconds, then read. null = silence or not measured yet.
methods.title: Read Meters

methods.name: analysis.capture

source.description: What to listen to: "master" or {"track": <id or index>}.

track.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Record what the master or one track plays for a few seconds (default 8, 1-30) and analyse it in the background: peak, true peak, RMS, crest factor, clipping, DC; LUFS integrated / short-term / momentary and loudness range, short-term per second; stereo correlation, width and mono loss; tonal balance (sub, bass, low-mid, mid, high-mid, high, air) and a 1/3-octave spectrum with per-band width. Starts playback if stopped. Returns a job id at once: call jobs.wait with it. One capture at a time.
methods.title: Listen

methods.name: analysis.file
methods.summary: Analyse an audio file (WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG, AIFF) the same way as analysis.capture: a reference track to compare the mix with (analysis.compare), or an exported master to master.check. Reads at most the first 10 minutes. Returns a job: jobs.wait for it.
methods.title: Analyse File

methods.name: analysis.compare

a.description: Job id from the call that started it.

b.description: Job id from the call that started it.

methods.summary: Where two finished captures (e.g. kick and bass, vocal and guitars) compete: band by band levels and the bands where both carry energy within a few dB of each other, strongest first. The usual cure is an EQ cut on one of them there (devices.add EQ + devices.set_params).
methods.title: Compare Captures

methods.name: jobs.get

job.description: Job id from the call that started it.

methods.summary: State (running / done / failed), progress and, once done, the result of a job started by another call.
methods.title: Job Status

methods.name: jobs.wait

job.description: Job id from the call that started it.

methods.summary: Wait until a job finishes (at most timeout_seconds, default and limit 9) and return it as jobs.get does; call again while it is still running.
methods.title: Wait for Job

methods.name: master.targets
methods.summary: Delivery targets: streaming platforms (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Tidal, Amazon Music, Deezer), podcast, broadcast (EBU R128, ATSC A/85) and a club convention, each with integrated LUFS, tolerance and true-peak ceiling.
methods.title: Loudness Targets

methods.name: master.check

target.description: Target id from master.targets, e.g. spotify, apple_music, ebu_r128, club.

methods.summary: Pass / fail of a finished master capture (analysis.capture of "master", or analysis.file of an exported mix) against a target: loudness gap in LU, true peak against the ceiling, the gain that would hit the target, and notes (short capture, clipping, over-limiting, phase).
methods.title: Check Against Target

methods.name: master.build_chain

target.description: Target id from master.targets, e.g. spotify, apple_music, ebu_r128, club.

methods.summary: Put a mastering chain at the end of the master: an optional glue Compressor (2:1, slow attack, soft knee) and a true-peak Limiter with its ceiling at the target's. With a capture job of the master, the compressor threshold and the limiter's input gain are set from it to approach the target loudness. Refuses if the master already has a Limiter (adjust that one with devices.set_params). One undo step. Then capture again and master.check.
methods.title: Build Master Chain

methods.name: export.render

dither.description: Dither when writing 16/24 bit (default: the export dialog's).

end_beat.description: End in beats (default: the song's end).

fast.description: Render offline, faster than real time (default false).

path.description: Absolute path of the .wav file to write.

target.description: Normalise to this target from master.targets while writing.

methods.summary: Render the arrangement (start_beat to end_beat, default the whole song) to a WAV file, as the Export dialog does: in real time through the audio device, or with fast offline (faster than real time, the same mix), optionally normalised to a loudness target. Returns a job: jobs.wait until done; the result has the path and an analysis of the written file. Writes only absolute .wav paths and does not overwrite unless asked. Session clips play only if recorded into the arrangement.
methods.title: Export Mix

methods.name: export.stems

dither.description: Dither when writing 16/24 bit (default: the export dialog's).

end_beat.description: End in beats (default: the song's end).

folder.description: Absolute path of an existing folder for the stems.

through_master.description: Keep the master chain on each stem (default false).

tracks.description: Tracks to render (default: every non-group track).

items.description: Track id (UUID string from tracks.list, stable) or 0-based index (shifts when tracks are added or moved).

methods.summary: Render one WAV per track (all audible tracks, or the ones listed) into a folder, offline and faster than real time: each stem is its track soloed, with its sends' returns, without the master chain unless through_master. Files are named '<NN> <track>.wav'. Returns a job whose result lists the files.
methods.title: Export Stems

methods.name: edit.undo
methods.summary: Undo the newest step in Omni's history (the user's or yours; every edit call of this API is one step labelled 'API: ...'). Returns what was undone.
methods.title: Undo

methods.name: edit.redo
methods.summary: Redo the step undone last. Returns what was redone.
methods.title: Redo
